text: Architect: the local ./child-page clone can hold only the initial commit (README title, LICENSE, .gitignore) while the team knowledge describes ~56 activities; check origin/main or re-clone before reviewing architecture from the code.

Architect: refresh the local ./child-page clone with `git -C child-page pull --ff-only` before any architecture review; a fresh workspace clone can hold only the initial commit while main has the full app (js/, docs/, tools/check.py, tag v1.0.0).

child-page architecture (2026-10-30): index.html loads ~81 scripts eagerly (~1.2 MB JS, 117 KB css/style.css); app.js (120 lines) routes by hash and calls a.mount(stage); sw.js install swallows per-file fetch failures. Proposed fix is lazy-loading each activity script from a src field in js/activities.js (ADR candidate).
